# Mixins

Mixin classes for theme elements and your own Lit components. 

Apply during class definition with the `with()` function:

```js
import { LitElement } from 'lit';
import { Mixin, MainDomElementMixin } from '@ucd-lib/cork-theme/utils/mixins';
class MyElement extends Mixin(LitElement).with(MainDomElementMixin) {}
```

- [MainDomElementMixin(superClass)](#maindomelementmixinsuperclass)
  - [createRenderRoot()](#createrenderroot)

## MainDomElementMixin(superClass)

set render context for lit element to main DOM instead of the
default shadow root

| Param | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `superClass` | `Class` | LitElement or child class. |

**Returns:** `Class` - LitElement updated createRenderRoot function.

### Methods

#### createRenderRoot()

set the root element to render into

**Returns:** `LitElement`

### Examples

**Render an element into the light DOM**

```js
import { LitElement } from 'lit';
import { Mixin, MainDomElementMixin } from '@ucd-lib/cork-theme/utils/mixins';

class MyElement extends Mixin(LitElement).with(MainDomElementMixin) {
  // static styles are added to the element as a style tag, since there's no shadow root
}
```
